mapper.sql: indicator_id, report_id, indicator_type, data_as_of, source, observed_value, change_value, change_rate, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_market_indicator WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY CASE indicator_type WHEN 'KOSPI' THEN 1 WHEN 'KOSDAQ' THEN 2 WHEN 'US_TREASURY_10Y' THEN 3 WHEN 'USD_KRW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT FROM daily_market_indicator WHERE indicator_type = #{indicatorType} AND data_as_of IS NOT NULL AND observed_value IS NOT NULL AND status != 'MISSING' AND data_as_of < #{beforeDate} ORDER BY data_as_of DESC, indicator_id DESC LIMIT 1
